$comment: REV 3 contract. FOUR groups (user directive): EE Box, Locomotion, Excavation, Deposition. Pipeline reparents source nodes into these groups (node name = 'group'); matchPatterns test L1 names, matchPatternsL2 test deeper descendants (shallowest match wins, never descend into a matched subtree), REMAINDER catches the rest. explodeDir must read as ONE coherent radial explosion from the locomotion base: things lift AWAY from the rolling chassis, no sideways drift that reads as random. Systems page iterates this array generically.

subsystems.title: Locomotion
subsystems.role: Four chain-driven wheel modules and the frame they carry — the rolling base everything mounts to.

subsystems.title: Excavation
subsystems.role: Bucket-ladder digging system that harvests lunar regolith.

subsystems.title: Deposition
subsystems.role: Collects and dumps harvested regolith into the sieve.

subsystems.title: Electrical Box
subsystems.role: Power distribution, motor controllers, and the wiring that animates every subsystem.

closing.title: Mission Operations
closing.role: Luna comes back together under the people who run the program.

pipeline.notes: PERF PASS (user reports lag): tighten simplify ratios (chains harder, structural to ~0.3), consider pruning sub-2cm fasteners. Strip transmission; force the two BLEND materials OPAQUE this time (no depth-sort risk, parts are never ghosted anymore). Perception folds into excavation (mast rides the ladder frame); chassis remainder folds into locomotion.
